hooks.command: echo '--- SESSION START ---' && head -30 PLAN.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No PLAN.md found — create one before starting work'

bash -c 'CMD=$(jq -r .command 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(main|production|prod|\-\-force|\.env\.local|service_role)"; then echo "SAFETY: Command touches protected resource. Review before proceeding: $CMD" >&2; fi; exit 0'
echo '--- SESSION END --- Run /token-audit if components were changed. Commit if stable.'
echo 'Context compacting — save any in-progress decisions to DECISIONS.md before continuing'
